item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We know what is at stake: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. We can build a future where clean energy, resilient infrastructure and abundant resources are realities.

2. We refuse to treat today’s engineering limits as permanent. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces—from energy storage to water purification.

3. We stand for a future beyond engineering bottlenecks. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. We must prepare to turn those solutions into shared progress.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We have a clear conviction: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. We see today’s hardest technical challenges—clean energy, resilient infrastructure, water scarcity and sustainable manufacturing—not as permanent barriers, but as problems that intelligence can overcome. We reject the idea that humanity must spend the next century trapped by the limits of today’s tools. We support building superintelligent AI and preparing to put its solutions to work. We must match that ambition with a commitment to making the benefits widely accessible. We are working toward a future defined by what humanity can build, not what it cannot.
